notes.title: Clockwork Sword April 24th Patch Notes
notes.content:
Some small changes  and fixes after the 1.0 release!

[h2]Updates:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Made some small changes to the tutorial area to help with smoother onboarding
[*] Buffed the electricity charge 'chain lightning' from 5 dmg -> 13 dmg, every 1.2 sec -> 1.0 sec
[*] Healthpacks can now be picked up even when the player is at full health
[*] Changed the default dash key to "L SHIFT". This can be re-bound in the settings.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an exploit related to the score where players could die and receive a single duplicate score per-level
[*] Attempted a fix at a rare bug causing players to not be able to dash on certain systems/regions
[/list]
Your feedback helps us to make some final tweaks and changes before we consider Clockwork Sword a finished game!

[h3]Thanks for playing,[/h3]

[i][b]Clockdrive Games[/b][/i]

notes.title: The Big 1.0 Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Fos3VTi.png[/img]
[h3]Hey Clockwork Players![/h3]
We have just now released our massive 1.0 update! This means we are officially out of Early Access and are a fully released game! Let's cover as many of the changes as we can.

[b]Firstly, check out our launch trailer:[/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x0XGBEHZxKg

[h2]New Content & Features[/h2]

[h3]The Lab Exhibit![/h3] 
This includes a new elemental charge (acid), 2 new enemies, and a new miniboss.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rZNXK9Q.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gfJ43zP.png[/img]
[h3]The Final Boss, Mechanical Hydra![/h3] 
The Hydra will present a tough challenge and a new POV during a multi-phase intense boss fight to close out the game with a bang!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jcvUSXb.png[/img]
[h3]The Score System![/h3] 
During gameplay, you'll earn points for killing enemies, clearing levels, and will receive more points based on how fast you take out each group of enemies and the final boss. This also comes with an online leaderboard! Compete with your friends and the world for the best possible score. (HINT: There [i]may [/i] also be some score-coins in boxes now!)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/amnP9to.png[/img]
[h3]Achievements![/h3] 
14 brand new achievements. These range from doing 300 dashes (easy) to killing the Hydra without any gears or elemental charges equipped (hard). Good luck!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/z3SAuxy.png[/img]

[h3]Chinese Language Localization![/h3]
The entire game now has Chinese localization. This should activate automatically if your system is default set to Chinese. However, it can also be manually turned on in the settings.

[h3]Huge Visual Upgrade![/h3]
Many visual improvements to every level, including new props, effects, and more!

[h3]Original Soundtrack[/h3]
Available for free download here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3473110/Clockwork_Sword_Soundtrack/

[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tons of new environmental props and decals across all levels.
[*] Replaced the cursor with a crosshair during gameplay.
[*] Soundscape overhaul, tons of new and improved sound effects and music.
[*] Adding a loading screen in between levels and loading checkpoints.
[*] Implemented controls rebinding.
[*] Re-formatted the settings menu for a better player experience.
[*] Changed the column to no longer damage the player, and do more damage overall.
[*] Improved all weapon-related and many other general visual effects.
[*] Improved menu functionality for better readability.
[*] While in the workbench, pressing 'ESC' will first eject you from the workbench without opening the menu.
[*] Miniboss fights will now lock the player in to the arena while the fight takes place.
[*] Overhauled the victory and death screens.
[*] Added a 'confirm' pop-up to the 'new game' option.
[*] Player can no longer attack while dashing.
[*] Made a small change to hover detection in the workbench for a smoother experience.
[*] Many visual and readability improvements to the player character, enemies, and hazards.
[*] Various small balance changes to gears, elemental charges, enemies, and weapons.
[*] Slight performance improvements across the board.
[*] Added an easter egg to the background of a level. Can you find it?
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Implemented a fix to an issue where settings selection was not being saved.
[*] Fixed issues related to progression-stopping bugs and checkpoint/save loading.
[*] Fixed the 'lifesteal' gear from causing game-wide issues when equipped.
[*] FIxed an issue with destructible object collisions causing areas for exploits and unintended gameplay.
[*] Solved a problem where occasionally elemental effects were not triggered properly.
[*] Made a change that allowed for the intended consistent triggering of the powder keg hazard.
[*] Fixed an issue related to workbench customization and the faulty reading of the player's pressure gauge.
[*] Made a change to the sword attack to prevent it from hitting enemies on the other side of walls.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing the 'first strike' gear to be unfunctional.
[*] A large amount of many other very small fixes and tweaks to improve the experience of the game!
[/list]
[i]As a reminder, this update will clear all previous saves. This is a fantastic opportunity to experience all the new content and go for that highscore![/i]

[b]And that's it! Tell your friends and family; Clockwork Sword has fully released! We hope you enjoy the update and the game, please leave us a review with your thoughts![/b]

[h3]Thanks for playing,[/h3]

[i][b]Clockdrive Games[/b][/i]

notes.title: Clockwork Sword April 1st Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]While it may be April Fools Day, this patch is no joke! [/b]
Let's give you a rundown of what's been changed and how it will effect the game.

[h2]Updates:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adding two more volume sliders to control for music & SFX separately
[*] Adjusted the the tutorial of the game to be more smooth & easy to follow 
[*] Improved the gameplay of most enemies in the game, including updating the visual feedback of the airship and coal cart bosses
[*] All levels received gameplay tweaks to checkpoints, healthpack placement, enemy activation, some minor layout changes
[*] The sword received a buff to its basic attack, and now its 'max attack' has 360 degree radius & improved feel
[*] Added screen mouse-lock
[*] Destructible objects now split into less pieces to help with performance & exploits
[*] Improved some VFX with enemies and weapons
[*] Minor update to the menu UI
[*] Slightly updated some item tooltips to be more readable and more accurate to gameplay
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed many issues related to the saving of the game and loading of checkpoints, including enemies breaking, weapon disappearing, dash not working, etc.
[*] Fixed a bug where the main menu would freeze animations upon opening other menus
[*] Fixed items sometimes disappearing after pickup
[*] Resolved an issue where the player would keep attacking after dying
[*] Fixed the blockus enemy still having a collider briefly after dying
[*] Fixed an issue where enemies could be bumped to non-playable areas.
[*] Healing auras are now consistent with intended radiuses from the curio turret enemy.
[*] Fixed UI-breaking issues that were sometimes caused by loading the next level
[/list]
[b]Please also note that the update will reset game progress, with the expectation that progress will reset at least once more for the 1.0 release.[/b]

Thanks for all your feedback so far, please keep it coming! Your feedback is directly helping improve the experience of the game, and the development team is actively monitoring it.

[h3]Thanks for playing, until next time![/h3]

[i][b]Clockdrive Games[/b][/i]

notes.title: Early Access Release / The Path to 1.0 / Feedback Survey
notes.content:
[b]Hey Clockwork players! 
[/b]We are now released onto Early Access, which is super exciting for our team! 
Now that you can get hands on with the game, we want to talk about what's coming in the future and how you can directly give us feedback.

[h2]Early Access Timeline[/h2]
We plan to release out of Early Access by the beginning of May 2025.

We'll use this time to work on our planned '1.0' content, collect feedback from our players, and perform an abundant amount of bugfixes, QoL improvements, and some visual upgrades.

We currently are not planning on doing weekly updates to fix bugs, as our timeline is fairly small. However, if you are encountering a severe bug, whether visual or game-breaking, please make sure to let us know!

[h2]The '1.0' Release Features[/h2]
As we plan to fully release by May, we want to share our plans for the further content that will be added to the game. This is what it currently looks like:
[list]
[*] [b]An entire new level-area, the *Lab* Exhibit![/b] This will include several new enemies, a new boss, and a new elemental charge to use on your weapon builds, 
[*] [b]Clockwork Sword's final boss, the *Mechanical Hydra*![/b] This will present a tough challenge and new POV during a multi-phase intense boss fight to close out the game with a bang!
[*] [b]A score system![/b] During gameplay, you'll earn points for killing enemies, clearing level-areas, and more points based on how fast you take out each encounter and the final boss. We are currently planning to link this to an online leaderboard so you can compete with your friends and the world to get the best score!
[*] [b]Achievements![/b] From easy to hard, we'll be adding achievements that will be tracked both internally and on your profile.
[*] Clockwork Sword's original soundtrack! Available for free download!
[*] Chinese localization!
[*] Tons of bugfixes, QoL changes, and visual improvements!
[/list]
[h2]Feedback Survey[/h2]
We want to hear from you! How you feel about the game, any improvements we can make, and any problems you are encountering while playing. 

If you'd like to help with this, please go to this survey and fill it out:
https://tinyurl.com/clockwork-sword-EA-feedback

[h3]Thanks for playing, until next time![/h3]

[i][b]Clockdrive Games[/b][/i]
